verses.text: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth, Who hast set thy glory upon the heavens!

segments.text: O Jehovah, our Lord,
How excellent is thy name in all the earth,
Who hast set thy glory upon the heavens!

verses.text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established strength, Because of thine adversaries, That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

segments.text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established strength,
Because of thine adversaries,
That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

segments.text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers,
The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

verses.text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?

segments.text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him?
And the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.text: For thou hast made him but little lower than God, And crownest him with glory and honor.

segments.text: For thou hast made him but little lower than God,
And crownest him with glory and honor.

verses.text: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:

segments.text: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands;
Thou hast put all things under his feet:

verses.text: All sheep and oxen, Yea, and the beasts of the field,

segments.text: All sheep and oxen,
Yea, and the beasts of the field,

verses.text: The birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

segments.text: The birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea,
Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

verses.text: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth!

segments.text: O Jehovah, our Lord,
How excellent is thy name in all the earth!

headings.text: For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of David.
